exposure: Robson Ten Group Classification System (TGCS) groups
outcome: relative and absolute group contributions to overall Cesarean section rates
cohort: Women who gave birth in three tertiary care hospitals in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, between June and August 2019.
finding: The overall Cesarean section rate was 39.9%, which is higher than the WHO recommended optimal rate, with Group 5 (women with previous Cesarean section) being the largest contributor to this rate.
mod_finding: Group 5 (women with a previous Cesarean section) was identified as the largest contributor to the overall Cesarean section rates.
